# Errors

Read from the code: every public name below, its signature and its docstring. Import `igni_service` — defined in `igni_service.errors`.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`VmProfileRefused`](#vmprofilerefused) | igni read the VM profile request and refused it. Sending it again will not help. |
| [`BundleError`](#bundleerror) | The extension bundle is unreadable, or could not be built. |
| [`ConfigurationError`](#configurationerror) | The service is missing something it needs to be part of igni. |
| [`EventRefused`](#eventrefused) | igni read the event and refused it. Sending it again will not help. |
| [`IgniError`](#ignierror) | Anything this SDK raises on purpose. |
| [`IgniUnavailable`](#igniunavailable) | igni server could not be reached, refused, or answered with something else. |
| [`KeyStoreError`](#keystoreerror) | This service's key cannot be stored or read. |
| [`NotificationRefused`](#notificationrefused) | igni read the notifications and refused them. Sending them again will not help. |
| [`ServiceNotApproved`](#servicenotapproved) | igni server holds this service's registration, and no super admin has approved it yet. |
| [`ServiceRevoked`](#servicerevoked) | A super admin revoked this service in igni's portal. Nothing it asks igni for works now. |

## VmProfileRefused

```python
class VmProfileRefused(IgniError)
```

Based on [`IgniError`](/docs/sdk/igni-service/reference-errors#ignierror).

## ServiceNotApproved

```python
class ServiceNotApproved(IgniUnavailable)
```

Based on [`IgniUnavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-service/reference-errors#igniunavailable).

igni server holds this service's registration, and no super admin has approved it yet.

A super admin approves it in igni's portal under *Services*, after
checking the thumbprint the service logged at start-up. Retrying
before then gets the same answer.

## ServiceRevoked

```python
class ServiceRevoked(IgniUnavailable)
```

Based on [`IgniUnavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-service/reference-errors#igniunavailable).

A super admin revoked this service in igni's portal. Nothing it asks igni for works now.
